Why Astronauts Are Your Closest Neighbors at Point Nemo

scenes.text: Where are astronauts closer than anyone on land?
The Arctic pole of inaccessibility sits frozen on ocean pack ice.
That frozen northern location sits about 626 miles from any landmass.
However, the South Pacific holds an even more remote oceanic location.
Point Nemo sits roughly 1,670 miles away from the nearest island.
If you float at this exact coordinate, human civilization is immensely far.
Yet when the space station passes directly overhead, that changes completely.
Astronauts orbit just 250 miles above your head in space.
That compares a 1,670 mile distance to land with a 250 mile orbital height.
When passing directly overhead, astronauts become your nearest living neighbors.
